Attack is described as "-style" rather than the exact released method, so medium confidence.

The paper reports CaptureGuard generalization results with a specific number against the named external benchmark: "54.77% on BIPIA Injection (vs InjecGuard 87.32%)." This is a direct evaluation against the BIPIA benchmark attack set.

SecMCP's evaluation corpus explicitly includes "PoisonedRAG-style misleading documents seeded with a synthetic fake-news corpus" used to realize the "misleading" risk category, with AUROC results reported across the combined risk-type evaluation. Constructed as "-style" rather than running the released PoisonedRAG attack verbatim, so medium confidence.
